title: Longest Common Subsequence
description:
Given two strings `text1` and `text2`, return the length of their **longest common subsequence**, or `0` if they share none.

A subsequence is formed by deleting some characters (possibly none) without reordering the rest.
constraints: Both strings contain only lowercase English letters.
hints: Let dp[i][j] be the answer for the first i characters of text1 and the first j of text2.
If the characters match, extend dp[i-1][j-1]; otherwise take the better of dp[i-1][j] and dp[i][j-1].
